title: Jack Henry Earns 10 WebAwards, Including Best Bank Website Recognition
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
*The company's web hosting and graphic design services honored in 18* *th* *annual WebAwards program*


MONETT, Mo.


, Oct. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) is pleased to share that 10 financial institutions have received 2026 WebAwards for websites built using Jack Henry web hosting and graphic design services, including the prestigious Best Bank Website award.


Great Southern Bank Community Matters, The First Bank, Cornhusker Bank, First Farm Bank, Wellworth Bank, Vibe Credit Union, Unison Credit Union, Kalsee Credit Union, Memphis City Employees Credit Union, and First Financial Credit Union were recognized for delivering modern, innovative, and user-centric digital experiences for their accountholders. All 10 websites submitted by Jack Henry earned recognition in this year's competition, demonstrating the strength of the company's web design services.


Among this year's honorees, Great Southern Bank's Community Matters website received the competition's highest distinction in the banking category, earning the 2026 Best Bank Website award.


"Our Community Matters site is where we tell the stories of the people and organizations we've been proud to support, so we wanted it to feel as personal as those stories are," said Tim Miano, Digital Marketing Manager at Great Southern Bank. "Jack Henry understood that from the start and helped us build something that's easy to explore and genuinely reflects who we are. We're grateful for the partnership and honored by the recognition."


These awards highlight Jack Henry's commitment to helping financial institutions create exceptional digital experiences to strengthen connections with the communities they serve. Now in its 18th year, the Web Marketing Association's WebAwards program is the longest-running annual website award competition dedicated to setting standards of excellence for website development. Experts from around the world judge sites across 86 industries on criteria such as design, innovation, content, interactivity, copywriting, and ease of use.


The 2026 WebAward winners included:


**Best Bank Website**


- [Great Southern Bank Community Matters](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=3474076452&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.greatsouthernbank.com%2F&a=Great+Southern+Bank+Community+Matters)


**Outstanding Website Awards**


- [The First Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=392243430&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thefirst.com%2F&a=The+First+Bank)
- [Cornhusker Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=3101548913&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cornhusker.bank%2F&a=Cornhusker+Bank)
- [Vibe Credit Union](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=4190888035&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vibecreditunion.com%2F&a=Vibe+Credit+Union)
- [Unison Credit Union](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=2118051374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.unisoncu.org%2F&a=Unison+Credit+Union)


**Standard of Excellence Awards**


- [First Farm Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=1185245727&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.firstfarmbank.com%2F&a=First+Farm+Bank)
- [Wellworth Bank](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=2375260863&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wellworth.bank%2F&a=Wellworth+Bank)
- [Kalsee Credit Union](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=50750796&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kalsee.com%2F&a=Kalsee+Credit+Union)
- [Memphis City Employees Credit Union](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=4109329064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.memphiscu.org%2F&a=Memphis+City+Employees+Credit+Union)
- [First Financial Credit Union](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=993111428&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ffcu.org%2F&a=First+Financial+Credit+Union)


For a full list of winners, please visit[WebAward.org.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788608-1&h=3180130587&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.webaward.org%2F&a=WebAward.org.)


**About Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.®** Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) is a well-rounded financial technology company that strengthens connections between financial institutions and the people and businesses they serve.
